messages.author: bd06ae2dced2e045
messages.subject: Error in observed.count.2 - expected.2 : non-conformable arrays
parts:
I'm trying to run double observer data and I keep getting the following error:

** Warning: Specified endpoints >  90 ; values reset.**
Error in observed.count.2 - expected.2 : non-conformable arrays
Calls: ddf.gof -> gof.io
Execution halted

I have looked over my data countless times and can't find any problems. I have tried loading in chunks of data to find where the actual problem is, and I can't pinpoint it that way either.  My data involves multiple species and each group of analyses is for each individual species.  Some of the species work, and some don't, so I don't think it's a general formatting issue.  (ie data for feral hogs runs smoothly but data for deer has errors, but all are in same data file) Has anyone else gotten this error before and how did you resolve it?
Thanks!

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Error in observed.count.2 - expected.2 : non-conformable arrays
parts:
Mary:

I don't have a complete answer for you, but my suspicion lies in the first warning you see:  "specified endpoints > 90"

That suggests to me that you have binned data and perhaps you also have truncation (possibly at 90) and the outer edge of the final bin might not match up with the truncation specified.  Does this sound plausible?  That might be why you get a vector of observed counts that don't match up with the vector of expected counts in your goodness of fit test.
